children: Binance's emergency insurance fund for users now holds over $1.27 billion worth of Bitcoin. That includes about $270 million in unrealized profit.
The fund is called SAFU, short for Secure Asset Fund for Users. Binance created it to cover customers if something goes badly wrong, such as a hack.
In mid-February 2026, Binance changed course. The exchange converted roughly $1 billion in stablecoins into 15,000 BTC.
The conversion wrapped up on February 12 with one final large purchase of 4,545 BTC. Bitcoin was trading at approximately $67,000 at the time.
At that price, the whole stash was worth approximately $1.005 billion.
By early May 2026, Bitcoin was trading above $81,000, and the fund's value had climbed past $1.2 billion. At that point, unrealized gains stood at approximately $217 million.
The fund's holdings were later reported at over $1.27 billion. Paper profit has reached about $270 million.
Binance has also made the fund's wallet public. The address is 1BAuq7Vho2CEkVkUxbfU26LhwQjbCmWQkD, and anyone can check its balance on-chain.
Binance said it would run regular audits of the fund. It also committed to a top-up rule: if the fund's market value falls below $800 million, Binance said it will restore it to $1 billion.
SAFU is not new. Binance set it up in July 2018, funding it with 10% of trading fees.
The fund has been called on before. It has covered user losses from security breaches, including a $40 million hack in 2019.
Binance has framed the 2026 conversion as a long-term view of Bitcoin as a reserve asset, citing Bitcoin's transparency, auditability, and its role as a hedge against inflation and counterparty risk.
For Binance customers, the fund worth over $1.27 billion is larger than the original $1 billion commitment. The fund now rises and falls with Bitcoin, with the $800 million floor as the safety rail.
A 15,000 BTC position held as long-term reserve is coins that are, in theory, not for sale during routine price swings.

Binance bought near $67,000, watched Bitcoin clear $81,000 by May, and is sitting on roughly a quarter-billion dollars in paper gains. Watch the wallet balance, the reported fund value relative to the $800 million line, and whether audits arrive on the schedule Binance promised.

title: Binance's SAFU fund holds $1.27B in Bitcoin, sits on about $270M profit
